title: Viking Ghost Ship Over Fields
description: A cloaked figure stands in a Viking longship floating above golden rolling hills at sunset. A massive swirling green and purple cosmic portal with glowing eyes dominates the starry night sky on the left.
prompt: A dramatic surreal fantasy scene of a hooded cloaked figure standing in a wooden Viking longship that floats above golden rolling hills and fields at sunset. The ship has a dragon head prow and detailed woodwork. To the left, a massive swirling green and purple cosmic portal with glowing circular eyes emerges from the starry night sky, while the right side shows a bright setting sun with orange and yellow clouds over distant mountains, in a detailed epic painting style.
